subject: Copywriting
title: The Line Between Persuasion and Manipulation
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Line Between Persuasion and Manipulation.

hook.text: A vitamin ad says 'boost your immune system.' A scam says 'cure your cancer.' Same format, different ethics.

buildup.text: Persuasion provides truthful information and lets people choose. Manipulation deceives or exploits vulnerability.

discovery.text: The test: would the customer still buy if they knew everything the copywriter knows? If yes, it's persuasion.

twist.text: Most copy lives in the gray zone. 'Limited time offer' is pressure, not a lie. Ethics requires judgment, not rules.

climax.text: The best copywriters make ethics a brand asset. Long-term trust generates more revenue than short-term tricks.

punchline.text: Persuade with truth. Manipulation breaks trust forever.

quiz.question: What distinguishes persuasion from manipulation?
options: Persuasion uses images; manipulation uses words
